dispositions.reason: The direct first-party evidence says LRLR indicates explosive moves, but it does not establish a direction, setup transition, trigger, entry, stop, target, invalidation, or other sufficiently bounded operational relationship. Treating that descriptive cue as a separate predicate would invent missing semantics.
dispositions.future_admission_condition: Admit only if additional direct first-party evidence establishes a bounded operational relationship and its relationship to MMBM/LRLR without generic-market inference.
